sql: SELECT c.settings->>'vamu3d_offer' AS modo, c.settings->>'vamu3d_offer_test_phone' AS tel, c.settings->>'vamu3d_offer_test_sent_at' AS teste_enviado, s.team_hours::text AS horario_equipe, now()::text AS agora FROM companies c LEFT JOIN ai_agent_settings s ON s.company_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
